# Messy Quality

This skill does stuff.

## /report daily

Produce the daily report from the latest export.

## /report weekly

Produce the weekly report from the latest export.

## Choose a path

If the input looks like CSV, parse it as rows. Otherwise treat it as JSON.

<!-- skillflow:gate -->
## Confirm the result

Verify the output is complete before finishing.

## Run the helper

Run scripts/cleanup.sh to tidy the workspace afterward.
